jobPlaceholder: Paste the full text of the job posting here…
englishOnly: This tool reads job posts and CVs written in English. It matches words with English word lists, so it can miss skills written in other languages.
statusMatching: Matching your CV to the posting
statusNeedInput: Add the job description and your CV to start.
statusPrivate: Your CV is read in this tab. Nothing is stored.
resultBody: Only skills that appear in both your CV and the posting, in the order the posting stresses them.
toastCopyFailed: Copy failed. Select the skills and copy them yourself.
proofHeading: Where your CV proves each one
noProof: Your CV names it but never shows it in use. Add one bullet where you did.
noSharedHeading: Your CV and this posting share no skills yet
noSharedBody: Nothing from the posting appears in your CV, so there is nothing safe to list. Check the gaps below, or paste the full posting with its requirements.
gapHeading: The job wants these, your CV does not show them
gapBody: List one only if you have really used it, and add a bullet that shows where.
ctaGapsTitle: {count, plural, one {# skill the job wants is} other {# skills the job wants are}} missing from your CV
ctaDoneTitle: Skills sorted. Now the rest of the CV
ctaBody: A skills list only helps when your bullets back it up. Sign up free and FitMyCV tailors your whole CV to this posting, using only your real experience.
ctaDoneLabel: Tailor my CV to this job
examplesBody: Yours will use only skills from your CV that the posting asks for. Here is the shape they take.
